up: For assay CHEMBL4888487, return the exact activity values and structures for all tested compounds. The output should include the following columns: activity_id, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and canonical_smiles. Use activities.record_id to join compound_records, then join compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Do not apply any filters on standard_relation or standard_value; include all rows for the specified assay.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4888487'
